facts: England is home to the world-famous London Marathon, one of the six World Marathon Majors.
Sir Roger Bannister broke the legendary four-minute mile barrier in Oxford, England, back in 1954.
The modern Olympic Games owe much to England's Much Wenlock Games, which inspired the international revival.
Football, cricket, rugby, and modern tennis all trace their formal rules back to 19th-century England.
England features over 140,000 miles of public footpaths, making it a paradise for trail runners.
Lake District National Park offers stunning fells, glacial lakes, and some of the finest fell running in the world.
Hadrian's Wall Path lets you run along an ancient Roman fortification stretching right across northern England.
Traditional English afternoon tea often includes warm scones served with rich clotted cream and sweet jam.
The South West Coast Path is England's longest national trail, spanning an impressive 630 miles of coastline.
Parkrun originated in Bushy Park, London, growing into a global weekly running phenomenon for all fitness levels.
Iconic landmark Stonehenge stands on Salisbury Plain, dating back over four thousand years to ancient times.
English countryside running is famous for its charming stone villages, rolling green hills, and historic countryside pubs.
The Great North Run, held annually in North East England, is the largest half marathon in the world.
William Shakespeare, England's most celebrated playwright, was born and buried in historic Stratford-upon-Avon.
England's national flower is the Tudor rose, a historic symbol adopted after the Wars of the Roses.
Fell running is a traditional English sport where athletes race up and down steep, rugged mountain terrain.
The Pennine Way is a rugged 268-mile trail following the mountainous spine of northern England.
Fish and chips remains one of England's most iconic comforting post-run national dishes.
The Cotswolds region is world-renowned for its picturesque honey-colored limestone villages and rolling footpaths.
Mo Farah, one of England's greatest distance runners, won four Olympic gold medals in track events.
